text:
rowan: following up from last night's OOMs — want to consolidate remediation actions and owners for the KV-cache leak so we can track progress and spot recurrence trends.

ekta: thanks. Quick summary: large pinned buffers created by streaming/batched reads are not being unpinned promptly. Fragmentation after compaction appears to delay reclamation, amplifying leaks.

omar: I'll take ownership of a fast repro harness + allocation traces. ETA: Wed midday. Will post flamegraph link.
ekta: I'll own GC knobs + slab allocator audit. Planning to try conservative slab growth and more frequent young-gen trimming. Need a staging run.

rowan: mitigation plan (short-term): 1) add soft limit for pinned entries per shard (default 25) behind feature flag, 2) emergency eviction that evicts oldest pinned entries when heap crosses waterline, 3) CI regression to detect pinned-memory growth.

omar: repro command (local):
```
$ ./tools/kv-load --shards 6 --concurrency 200 --batch-size 120 --duration 90s --endpoint http://localhost:8080/prefetch
```

omar: initial heap dump points to ~28-36MB buffers from kv::PinnedSlice produced in BatchReader::drain. I'm adding pin/unpin instrumentation to trace lifecycle.

ekta: proposed GC changes: slab-grow-threshold 0.8 -> 0.6, add trim after 4k requests, and a short aggressive pass when emergency_evict triggers. Will bench and post numbers.

rowan: can we get a canary of the guardrail (soft limit + emergency_evict behind flag) by Fri 02:00 UTC? Would like to roll 15% and run stress tests.

omar: yes, canary by Fri 02:00 UTC. I'll open PR and include a simple rollback toggle.

infra-bot: scheduled mem-stress run mem-check-198888 for Fri 01:30 UTC against canary deployment (job link: /ci/reports/mem-check-198888).

ekta: also adding metric kv.fragmentation_percent and alert: fragmentation_percent > 28 for 15m. That should help surface compaction-related spikes.

rowan: long-term items: a) make eviction compaction-aware so we prefer freeing ranges impacted by compaction pauses, b) audit slab allocator growth policy and consider slab defragmenter, c) dataset of failing traces for regression tests. Assign owners: ekta (a+b), omar (c). RFC for (a) due next Wednesday.

omar: I'll produce a small dataset of 10 failing traces and add to ci/artifacts. Also adding a unit test that fails if pinned growth > 100MB in 5 minutes under synthetic load.

ekta: agree on staggering compactions across shards to avoid correlated fragmentation — adding chore and pinging infra team.

rowan: runbook updates: detection rule (OOM spike + sustained kv.pinned_bytes growth), immediate mitigations (flip emergency_evict, reduce client concurrency), oncall playbook for investigating pinned buffer owners. I'll open runbook PR and include the canary rollout checklist.

omar: PRs in progress: #5112 guardrail + flag, #5118 repro + CI regression. ekta will post GC tuning PR after perf runs.

rowan: please update this thread as PRs are opened, canary starts, and QA completes. We'll reconvene next Monday to check whether recurrence rate drops.

ekta: ack — will post staging benchmark numbers.

omar: ack — starting tracing now, will post flamegraph link in thread.

miriam: thanks all. Let's keep the oncall informed via the runbook, and escalate if emergency_evict flips more than 3 times in an hour.
